title: Smoked Irish Treacle Ribs
description: A twist on traditional BBQ ribs, these German-inspired Irish treacle ribs are smoky, sweet, and fall-off-the-bone tender.
instructions: Remove the membrane from the back of the ribs and pat dry with paper towels.
In a small bowl, mix together treacle, BBQ sauce, and smoked paprika.
Apply the treacle mixture evenly to both sides of the ribs.
Place the ribs on the grill, bone-side down, and close the lid.
Smoke the ribs for 2 hours, or until they reach an internal temperature of 160°F (71°C).
After 2 hours, increase the grill temperature to 375°F (190°C) and cook for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the ribs are caramelized and tender.
Remove the ribs from the grill and let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
